userRequirement: JetBrains 제품이나 별도로 판매되는 상용 확장의 라이선스·구독에 의존하지 않고 독립적으로 만든다.

runtimeRequirements.openSourceComponentReuse: 소스와 배포 조건을 확인한 구성요소를 Rocketbrain 소유 클라이언트·배포물에 직접 통합할 수 있다. 최상위 저장소의 라이선스만으로 전체 배포물의 검토가 완료된 것으로 보지 않는다.

excludedRequiredProviders.reason: 별도 상용 엔진·구독 경로이므로 필수 공급자로 채택하지 않는다.
다른 제품의 유료 범위와 내부 API에 제품 핵심을 의존시키지 않는다.
설치된 IntelliJ IDEA·DataGrip 바이너리, JAR, 런타임, 계정 또는 라이선스 검사를 제품 실행 경로로 사용하지 않는다.
무료 설치 가능하다는 이유로 타사 VSIX를 추출·재배포하거나 필수 기능 공급자로 가정하지 않는다.

ownership.client: Rocketbrain이 VS Code 명령·화면·작업 공간·LSP/DAP 연결을 소유한다.
ownership.javaAndSpring: Rocketbrain이 공개 Java LSP/DAP 수명주기와 자체 Spring/JPA 모델, typed JPQL AST·bounded dynamic Java·symbolic SpEL·pure naming source/profile, Java/XML cross-URI references와 owner별 physical bindings를 소유한다. Actuator metadata/DB catalog/실제 query 실행 관찰은 정적 모델과 분리한다. v0.7 adds owned JDK-agent sources, explicit provider semantic observation and separately tagged application/manual-validation event origins.
ownership.database: 드라이버·파서와 별도로 SQL 문맥 모델, 메타데이터 캐시, 연결별 세션, 트랜잭션과 변경 제출 상태를 소유한다.
ownership.interaction: 키맵·검색·편집기·결과 그리드의 동작 명세와 검증을 직접 관리한다.
ownership.distribution: 구성요소 버전·출처·해시·고지문·해당 소스 제공 범위를 기록하고 독립 환경에서 배포물을 검증한다.

acceptanceGates: JetBrains 제품과 타사 Marketplace 확장이 없는 별도 시험 환경에서 핵심 기능이 동작한다.
제품 기능을 열기 위해 JetBrains 또는 타사 상용 제품의 계정·구독·체험 활성화를 요구하지 않는다.
공개 소스 구성요소는 고정한 revision·배포물의 전이 의존성과 재배포 조건까지 확인한다.
필요한 Java 런타임은 별도 공개 배포 경로로 공급하거나 명시적인 일반 JDK 경로를 사용한다. 원본 IDE의 런타임을 찾는 fallback은 두지 않는다.
동일한 Java·Spring 및 MySQL/MariaDB 예제에서 기능별 동작과 알려진 제한을 검증한다.
SQL 파싱 성공, 의미 분석 성공, DB 실행 성공, UI 상태 일치를 서로 다른 판정으로 기록한다.
원본 프로그램은 화면·동작을 비교하는 참조이며 제품 실행 의존성이 아니다.
VS Code 전체 창 구조의 정확한 교체는 일반 확장 API 한계로 별도 요구사항 결정을 남긴다.
지원 query AST 구성요소의 coverage와 known/invalid/unknown을 구분하고 미확정 문법·형식·바인딩을 완전한 유효성 판정으로 확대하지 않는다.
동적Java의 알려진/유한 후보와 source URI별 원본 span을 보존한다. 분석 목적으로 사용자Java·SpEL·naming전략·query를 실행하지 않는다.
SpEL의 고정 String서명은 반환형/인수형만 추론하며 임의bean·reflection·method는 미확정으로 남긴다.
지원 naming source/profile과 quoting의 certainty를 보존하고 미지원 전략·default joins를 임의standard naming으로 대체하지 않는다.

runtimeObservationPolicy.comparison: 정적 unknown과 관찰을 분리하고 runtime absence/source revision을 단정하지 않는다.
runtimeObservationPolicy.scope: Spring Actuator only; provider observation has its own policy

jpaAnalysisPolicy.mappingFiles: 기본 META-INF/orm.xml과 명시 mappingFiles만 bounded local input으로 읽는다. 생성 bin/out/build/target은 자동 발견에서 제외하며 genuine overlap은 unknown 처리한다.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.xml: Strict namespace/구조 subset; no DTD/external entities. XML-only/metadata-complete/override/named-query는 localJava결합과source ranges를유지한다. 불가독/충돌/미지원metadata가 확정된annotationdefaults로돌아가지않는다.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.physical: owner별 table/column/type와 implicit/physical/quoted naming certainty를분리한다. parent/embedded XMLpartial과configuredunknown을전파하며 accountvisibility/case를DB절대부재로간주하지않는다.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.converters: Source mapping analysis reads generic/autoApply/Convert metadata and does not execute converter bodies. Live provider mapping metadata is observed separately.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.queries: 지원 AST의 Java 도메인 형식·함수/DTO/파라미터/대입 계약을 검사한다. known은 coverage가 지원한 구성요소에서 미확정 부분을 찾지 않았다는 뜻이며 전체 JPQL/HQL provider 문법·모든 실행 유효성·IDE 동등성의 판정이 아니다.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.naming: explicit localFQN의pure source subset 및explicit/observed profile만bounded해석한다. 이름결정을위해source코드·DBquery를실행하지않고catalog로profile을추측하지않는다. 미지원전략/Unicode변환/implicitjoin문맥은unknown이며standardfallback을두지않는다.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.providerObservation: Explicit loopback Bearer agent; observed runtime metadata and source unknowns remain separate.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.arbitraryCode: Actual application paths/inputs can be observed; universal arbitrary-code analysis and same-source-build identity are not claimed.
jpaAnalysisPolicy.semanticValidation: Manual provider SQM compilation only; no observer SQL execution or binding. Configured compiler callbacks may run.

providerRuntimeObservationPolicy.authentication: Mandatory Bearer; VS Code Secret Storage
providerRuntimeObservationPolicy.events: Application and explicit semantic validation origins are distinguished on the instrumented thread.
providerRuntimeObservationPolicy.providerCallbacks: Configured compiler callbacks may run during explicit validation. The observer does not request SQL execution or binding.

javaTestingPolicy.framework: Pinned separately provisioned JUnit Platform6.0.3 and TestNG7.11.0; owned embedded launcher source
javaTestingPolicy.coverage: Actual JaCoCo0.8.16 aggregate plus explicit serial callback-interval per-test measurements; shared/configuration intervals separately unattributed; background/async causal exclusivity not claimed
javaTestingPolicy.dirtyBuffers: Save before compiled testing; changed source/class inputs suppress coverage mapping
javaTestingPolicy.debug: Windows managed suspended test JVM only; OS-verified loopback PID ownership and marked native DAP session; cancellation/disposal await owned operations
javaTestingPolicy.frameworkLifecycle: JUnit includes per-test lifecycle; TestNG test callbacks exclude BeforeMethod/AfterMethod, which remain unattributed
javaTestingPolicy.unsupported: JPMS test launching, remote tests, every TestNG factory/retry/listener configuration and other-OS debug ownership remain unverified or unsupported

sqlAnalysisPolicy.catalog: Explicit connect/refresh cached current-account catalog and observed server SQL mode/name rules
sqlAnalysisPolicy.supported: Scoped CTE/derived/correlated/UNION name and projection contracts
sqlAnalysisPolicy.unknown: Unsupported grammar, coercion, recursion, incomplete input and stale script DDL/session context remain uncertain
sqlAnalysisPolicy.rename: Existing statement-local rename plus separately reviewed catalog table/column source edits across selected query roots; snapshot/hash/version/file inventory guards; database DDL has its own explicit operation
sqlAnalysisPolicy.workspaceReferences: Bounded SELECT-only local .sql roots, semantic catalog provenance and explicit unknown file coverage; references include implicit outputs and wildcard impact without blind text replacement

schemaRenamePolicy.pinnedPrecondition: Server identity, fresh structural fingerprint and WRITE lock through DDL
schemaRenamePolicy.postcondition: Observed selected object attributes/indexes and visible FK metadata; not universal reference or concurrency proof
schemaRenamePolicy.hiddenDependencies: Explicit separate acknowledgment required; never claimed absent or automatically approved
schemaRenamePolicy.sourceEdits: Separate source plan and application; changed files after database DDL remain pending, no distributed atomicity claim

gridBrowsePolicy.draftsAndTransactions: Page/sort/filter changes refuse drafts and unresolved transactions. Explicit rollback-to-read-only is separate user action.

schemaComparisonPolicy.capture: Fresh bounded account-visible metadata only; no row data; multiple reads are not an atomic snapshot
schemaComparisonPolicy.comparison: Canonical table, column, index, foreign key, check, partition, option and raw view-definition differences; routines, triggers and privileges excluded
schemaComparisonPolicy.migration: Selected additive SQL review/export and explicitly acknowledged product application for nullable NULL-default ordinary columns, ordinary nonunique BTREE indexes and simple empty supported InnoDB tables

gridBulkPolicy.null: Explicit unquoted NULL token is distinct from quoted token and empty text
gridBulkPolicy.operations: Loaded rectangular paste, explicit field mapping, duplicate without generated/primary-key values
gridBulkPolicy.writePath: Stage into an unchanged empty draft, then existing Review, Apply and explicit Commit; no direct import SQL

schemaMigrationPolicy.execution: One-shot private reviewed additive plan on a dedicated owned write connection; explicit implicit-commit acknowledgment; per-step outcomes and fresh target checks
schemaMigrationPolicy.transactionIsolation: Refuse running, queued, manual, active, unknown or disconnected console work; never commit a console transaction
schemaMigrationPolicy.concurrency: Rocketbrain advisory coordination plus per-existing-table WRITE lock and fresh structural observation; CREATE collision is a server error; no universal external-DDL exclusion or cross-step atomicity
schemaMigrationPolicy.recovery: Stop after error, cancellation or failed postcondition; no automatic retry or reverse DDL; acknowledge applied, failed, not-run and uncertain outcomes
schemaMigrationPolicy.guard: Workspace trust, current connection epoch, server identity, SQL mode, immutable selected SQL and fresh schema preconditions
schemaMigrationPolicy.lockRequirements: Dedicated autocommit=0 with innodb_table_locks=1 around each existing-target WRITE lock; user console modes unchanged; MariaDB Galera/wsrep is refused

schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.workflow: Immutable reviewed typed InnoDB shadow rebuild or retained table removal; explicit destructive/implicit-commit acknowledgment; original table/data retained with a durable owned database journal
schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.scope: Supported ordinary column type/default/nullability/order/removal, primary/unique/index and supported CHECK changes; unsupported dependencies are refused
schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.publish: MySQL reviewed multi-name RENAME and MariaDB journaled ALTER RENAME steps differ; no uniform cross-step atomicity claim
schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.recovery: Automatic compensation after known failures plus explicit guarded inspection/recovery; schema and row digests under locks must match before restoring originals; changed live data is not overwritten
schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.uncertainty: Inspect actual owned object and journal states after lost acknowledgments; no blind DDL replay or automatic backup deletion
schemaRebuildRecoveryPolicy.dependencies: Visible dependencies blocked; hidden stored definitions require a separate explicit acknowledgment and are never claimed absent
excluded: foreign-key or trigger/view dependent rebuilds without verified support
recovery that overwrites intervening application data

schemaDependencyPolicy.workflow: Capture same-server schema-qualified typed FK/view/trigger graph and complete supported definitions/context; selected rebuild tables stay in the active schema; immutable dependency DDL and owned fences are journaled and revalidated around rebuild/recovery
schemaDependencyPolicy.approval: Separate explicit acknowledgment for temporary dependency changes; hidden affected definitions cannot be bypassed with an acknowledgment
schemaDependencyPolicy.writeFence: Reviewed owned BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE guards block application DML across affected tables/shadows until dependency/data checks finish; interrupted or manual-recovery states can retain guards and must be reported
schemaDependencyPolicy.foreignKeys: Supported same-server incoming/outgoing/self/cyclic FK graphs across schemas; exact qualified identities and actual relationship/type/key/nullability validation; FK checks remain enabled
schemaDependencyPolicy.metadataCapability: Preexisting direct global SELECT/SHOW VIEW/TRIGGER and PROCESS/global FK dictionary visibility plus actual affected-schema change rights; incomplete or role-only visibility is refused; product never grants privileges
schemaDependencyPolicy.triggerViewContext: Preserve observed definition, security/definer, ordering and SQL/character context or refuse unsupported cases
schemaDependencyPolicy.environment: Current-server normal client DML scope; known read-only, group replication/wsrep and log-bin non-ROW contexts are refused; operators must quiesce replication/appliers/administrator DDL outside ordinary trigger fencing
schemaDependencyPolicy.limits: Bounded observed same-server table/FK/view/program graph; cross-server coordination has a separate explicit saga policy
schemaDependencyPolicy.failure: Retained originals and durable dependency state support guarded compensation; changed live objects/data are not overwritten and uncertain outcomes are not blindly replayed
schemaDependencyPolicy.journalCompatibility: Ordinary typed rebuild planformat3 records owned UTC requirements; spatial typed-copy projection uses planformat4. Qualified dependency bundleformat2 is distinct from validated v13 plans and v14 local bundleformat1. Ordinary legacy digest semantics remain validated; ambiguous escaped routine summaries or old MySQL GEOMCOLLECTION SRS records may refuse conservatively. Raw client/journal SQL is never trusted.

structuredTriggers.unsupported: Unknown executable syntax, handlers/cursors, recursive CALL, trigger-reachable dynamic SQL/resultsets, unsupported scalar/subquery forms and unprovable target/read sets

schemaDependencyPolicy.coordination: Same-server v15 rebuild/recovery acquires one shared advisory coordinator before the existing active-database coordinator, including legacy recovery; active-schema differences cannot interleave owned graph transitions. External/older clients and administrators are outside this lock. This same-server lock does not itself coordinate cross-server operations; see schemaCoordinatorPolicy.

schemaConversionPolicy.workflow: Explicit typed per-column conversion descriptors are immutable, reviewed and journaled; no user SQL, code or functions
schemaConversionPolicy.validation: Deterministic transformed rows are compared with observed target semantics before publication; overflow, ambiguity and unsupported cases fail before replacing originals
schemaConversionPolicy.loss: Lossy transformation requires a supported explicit strategy and separate approval; no silent rounding, truncation or fallback casts
schemaConversionPolicy.recovery: Original values and schema remain in retained originals; conversion rules do not replace data/ownership/counter guards during recovery
schemaConversionPolicy.additional: Four YEAR4 strategies, canonical binary hex/base64 encode/decode, four explicitly reviewed UTC TIMESTAMP/calendar/text strategies; explicit approved EPSG4326/3857 vertex projection
schemaConversionPolicy.year: 0000 remains distinct fromNULL; only0 or1901..2155 accepted; no two-digit century inference
schemaConversionPolicy.binary: Uppercase even-length hex without prefix and canonical padded RFC4648 base64 without whitespace; empty andzero bytes preserved
schemaConversionPolicy.utc: Immutable timezone:UTC rule; verify dedicated workerUTC before source/target observation and guarded recovery; user console timezone unchanged; UTC operations refuse literal TIMESTAMP defaults; only supported absent/NULL/CURRENT_TIMESTAMP defaults
schemaConversionPolicy.unsupportedAdditional: Named timezone/DST inference and unsupported spatial formats/operations remain explicit; see schemaSpatialPolicy

streamImportPolicy.workflow: Local source inspection and full reviewed validation, then bounded batches on one dedicated transaction; final Commit or Roll Back is explicit
streamImportPolicy.sourceGuard: Exact source hash/file identity, immutable mapping/options, server/schema and connection epoch pinned
streamImportPolicy.failure: Validation/error/cancellation rolls back every uncommitted batch; commit acknowledgment loss is uncertain and never auto-retried
streamImportPolicy.transactionScope: InnoDB row changes; ordinary server-side AUTO_INCREMENT allocations can leave gaps after rollback
streamImportPolicy.memory: Stream source/selected worksheet with backpressure; retain bounded metadata/preview/batch only
streamImportPolicy.metadataScope: 8 MiB per metadata part, 20k shared strings and 200k parsed XML nodes per part; worksheet row queue bounded to 4096 rows/2 MiB; no measured RSS guarantee
streamImportPolicy.automaticRollback: Unconfirmed pending import expires after five minutes and rolls back; no implicit commit or automatic resume

xlsxImportPolicy.runtime: Pinned open-source ZIP and XML readers bundled with Rocketbrain; no Excel/Office or spreadsheet authoring runtime required
xlsxImportPolicy.workflow: Local bounded XLSX, explicit worksheet/header/field mapping and formula/blank policies, then existing unchanged-draft Review/Apply/Commit pipeline
xlsxImportPolicy.execution: Spreadsheet formulas, macros and external links are never executed or fetched; cached formula values need explicit selection and are not recalculated
xlsxImportPolicy.precision: Preserve numeric lexical precision, explicit text and supported calendar date conversion; unsupported or ambiguous cells are rejected

sqlScriptPolicy.preflight: Entire batch boundaries, observed session SQL mode, bindings and policy checked before execution; server syntax and semantic success are not guaranteed
sqlScriptPolicy.parameters: Named or positional prepared values; exact integer/decimal/date/JSON descriptor strings retain precision, server column or CAST supplies conversion
sqlScriptPolicy.reuse: Explicit RAM-only reuse scoped by document text, SQL selection, connection epoch/ID, SQL mode and keys; cleared on document close/disposal
sqlScriptPolicy.resultPrivacy: Review and binding metadata omit values; actual query results may echo parameter values
sqlScriptPolicy.execution: Single console queue, stop on first error/cancellation/budget; no automatic retry or transaction wrapper; earlier successes preserved
sqlScriptPolicy.ddl: Explicit implicit-commit approval; active transaction rejects schema scripts

javaRefactoringPolicy.engine: Independently provisioned public Eclipse JDT LS protocols with owned review and reference guards
javaRefactoringPolicy.edits: Bounded local Java edits and individual-file rename/delete; private plans, version/buffer/disk/project/resource-membership/trust guards; explicit non-overwriting file restoration; no arbitrary client command execution
javaRefactoringPolicy.supportedScope: Reviewed pure static members and immutable final instance state/explicit parameter or final direct field receivers, nested Java utility packages and proven standard main UTF-8 text resources. Existing literal Gradle DAG/composite and Maven reactor graphs additionally admit immutable dependency constants and finite exhaustive property branches, requiring compile visibility in every conservative scenario. Generic signature checks retain source substitution, covariance, bounds, erasure and caller results. Spring annotation/literal contracts additionally retain every target/name/alias from supported exhaustive metadata-dependent selector/registrar branches. Independent compiler and exact before/after declaration/caller/resource guards remain. Each declared client that can compile against the source in any reviewed scenario must compile against the destination in every reviewed scenario before a cross-project candidate is requested.
javaRefactoringPolicy.verification: Actual Spring and both DBs, current source/VSIX evidence at documented bounded scopes; not full product parity.
javaRefactoringPolicy.resourceOperations: Text edits remain unsaved; native file rename/delete affects disk. Text edits and moves support native Undo. File deletion closes its only editor and uses an explicit owned restore action rather than a claimed working file Ctrl+Z. No operation is atomic against arbitrary external writers. Non-Java resources are rename-only, exact URI-pair/byte-hash authorized UTF-8 snapshots; text edits and deletions are not generalized to resources.
javaRefactoringPolicy.fileRestoration: Private exact disk-byte snapshot, at most10combined records and2MiB/file, current session only for1hour; target absence/case, physical parent/workspace identity, trust and dirty-buffer guards; one-shot native createFile without overwriting.
javaRefactoringPolicy.remaining: Mutable state, custom constructors, source-state passing, effectful/external receivers; arbitrary resource formats/loaders/configuration references and new destination folders; procedural settings/plugins/build scripts and dependency edits; arbitrary generic/binary/framework clients and computed runtime Spring behavior remain incomplete.
javaRefactoringPolicy.compilerAnalysis: Owned JDK compiler parse/analyze helper, no project application/processor/plugin execution; explicit empty processor/source paths, cleared JVM option environment, guarded compiler classpath providers and manifests.

schemaProgramPolicy.workflow: Explicit read-only observed procedure dependency report; no user-program execution during analysis
schemaProgramPolicy.supported: Context-free conservative dependency paths and separate explicit-invocation analysis; branch/finite-loop prepared state, nonrecursive CALL session state and IN/OUT/INOUT propagation without running user programs; resolved SQL templates are one supported statically named SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only
schemaProgramPolicy.termination: Only proven simple-counter bounds are known; unknown termination is explicit, not a universal termination proof
schemaProgramPolicy.unsupported: Arbitrary user execution, dynamic DDL, unknown/infinite paths, recursion, trigger-reachable dynamic SQL/resultsets, unproved SQL coercion, functions/UDFs, handlers/cursors and unsupported grammar; dynamic CALL, CTE, UNION and general JOIN templates
schemaProgramPolicy.context: Explicit invocation cases are inspection-only and never reusable as universal migration dependency proof. Bound-value summaries are types/hashes; resolved SQL text/literals derived from inputs may be visible in the readonly report.

schemaSpatialPolicy.srid: Legacy0Cartesianxy/4326longitude-latitude plus separately reviewed EPSG4326/3857 vertex reprojection; explicit direction/axes, no SRID relabel
schemaSpatialPolicy.coordinates: Exact WKT binary64 default or explicitly approved nearest-even with changed-row/coordinate counts; WKB finite bits preserved and actual target WKB/SRID verified
schemaSpatialPolicy.unsupported: Composite/prefix spatial indexes, arbitrary SRS/datum grids, densification/dateline/topology repair, geometry-to-WKT, EMPTY/Z/M/EWKB/GeoJSON and nonfinite/negative-zero WKB; Maria nested parenthesized MULTIPOINT
schemaSpatialPolicy.reprojection: Owned bounded spherical Web Mercator formula and parameterized WKB copy; separate loss approval and actual target bits/SRID verified; retained original values and restrictions
schemaSpatialPolicy.indexes: Single full NOT NULL geometry column, InnoDB SPATIAL/R-tree; MySQL explicit column SRID restriction, Maria planar index semantics; add/drop/rebuild/recovery
schemaSpatialPolicy.legacyRecovery: A v0.16 MySQL GEOMCOLLECTION journal with unobserved column SRS metadata is refused before effects; unknown metadata is never normalized away.

schemaCoordinatorPolicy.participants: 2..4 distinct server identities, one active-schema participant/server; private live services and SecretStorage credentials
schemaCoordinatorPolicy.workflow: Immutable reviewed participant plans, deterministic owned worker/guardian locks, durable coordinator/participant decisions and held ordinary-DML fences until verified release
schemaCoordinatorPolicy.recovery: Before commit decision guarded compensation; after durable commit decision verified completion; reconcile lost acknowledgments/reconnect using typed journals; never blind forward-DDL retry
schemaCoordinatorPolicy.unsupported: Universal external application/admin coordination, cross-server FK constraints, atomic XA DDL, arbitrary remote SQL and unsafe overwrite after drift/unreachable participants
schemaCoordinatorPolicy.durability: Owned guardian/identity sessions explicitly enable and verify autocommit using server SQL and MySQL protocol transaction-status flags before journal work. Independent real observers verify commit decisions before fence release; user console modes remain unchanged.

schemaDdlAtomicityPolicy.sameServerAtomicStatement: Conditional documented engine guarantee; not a multi-statement or cross-server DDL transaction; crash behavior not experimentally proved
schemaDdlAtomicityPolicy.atomicRequests: Rejected before lookup, exclusive scheduling, connections, review or DDL with no silent saga fallback
schemaDdlAtomicityPolicy.observations: Owned actual MySQL/Maria probes for implicit commit, failed multi-rename, ACTIVE-XA DDL refusal and cross-server partial state surviving rollback

dailyJavaPolicy.supported: Observed imported Java source/package/library/JDK model; explicit native Maven lifecycle/Gradle task handles; saved observed-main Run/Debug with private environment values, successful prelaunch build and owned stop
dailyJavaPolicy.execution: Trusted initial JDT import and source autobuild remain; changed build configuration requires explicit synchronization. Project/build tasks may execute project code.
dailyJavaPolicy.unsupported: Universal JDK/Lombok/JPMS/multi-root composite-project parity, arbitrary server commands or full configuration-template catalog

springProjectPolicy.supported: Explicit official Initializr metadata/Java Maven or Gradle ZIP in new absent directory; bounded safe private review and supported literal starter dependency edits with source/version/context checks
springProjectPolicy.execution: Writes inside an open trusted workspace require explicit project-execution acknowledgement; synchronization is a separate explicit action
springProjectPolicy.unsupported: Overwrite or merge existing directories, arbitrary procedural build rewrites, version catalogs and unobserved BOM configurations

connectionProfilesPolicy.supported: 32 workspace profiles with groups/colors, one active connection, verified credential storage, visible schema selection, credential-free exports and local-path-free import metadata; strict TLS CA/DNS identity, paired PEM client certificates and owned system OpenSSH key/agent loopback forwards
connectionProfilesPolicy.credentials: Passwords in VS Code Secret Storage only after verification; private keys read from user-selected local paths; no credential/key data in profile metadata/export/reports. SSH imports require local verified host/key paths again.
connectionProfilesPolicy.guards: Pending grid drafts prevent switching; explicit native acknowledgement before rollback/switch of open or uncertain console transactions; fresh trust/epoch checks; close DB sessions before owned tunnel
connectionProfilesPolicy.unsupported: Simultaneous active data sources, password/interactive SSH authentication, unknown host-key auto-acceptance, SSH password import/export or arbitrary SSH options

databaseAuthoringPolicy.supported: Private typed table designer for supported InnoDB CREATE/ALTER/PK/index/FK/CHECK/default shapes; actual owned empty-table validation then reviewed schema application/rebuild/recovery; editable existing view SELECT/procedure BODY with typed original context/grants retained
databaseAuthoringPolicy.guards: Private model/review identities and connection epochs; trust, busy, draft and transaction checks before owned validation DDL; compile without executing SELECT/procedure BODY
databaseAuthoringPolicy.routineReplacement: Explicitly non-atomic DROP/CREATE. Temporary unavailability, retained typed original journal, actual known automatic own grant preservation; other/unknown grants and changed definitions refuse. Unknown outcomes are never automatically retried; guarded fresh-client restoration is explicit.
databaseAuthoringPolicy.unsupported: Arbitrary complete DDL passthrough, source CREATE, all routine types/grants, unsupported generated/partitioned tables and unproved transformations
